title: Propagation of Chaos for Nonlinear Markov Chains
summary: We study 1-Wasserstein propagation of chaos for "McKean-type" nonlinear Markov chains and their associated interacting particle systems. This paper is organized into two parts: the first part combines arguments from various areas of nonlinear Markov theory into a systematic treatment of quantitative, nonasymptotic empirical measure estimates and propagation of chaos, with Lipschitz regularity as the primary tool.
